infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: ASAB uses the camera so you can record a video to post, take a profile photo, or join a live video call.
infoPlist.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: ASAB uses the microphone so you can record audio on videos you upload, speak in live streams, and talk during voice or video calls.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: ASAB uses your photo library so you can choose a profile picture on Edit Profile, pick a photo or video to post, or attach an image in chat. For example, you can select a photo from Recents to set as your avatar.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryAddUsageDescription: ASAB may save a photo or video you create in the app, such as a recorded clip, to your photo library if you choose to keep it.
infoPlist.NSLocalNetworkUsageDescription: ASAB uses the local network to connect live video calls and livestreams on the same Wi-Fi network.
infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: ASAB uses your location to show you on the friends live map and share your location with people you choose.
infoPlist.NSLocationAlwaysAndWhenInUseUsageDescrip: ASAB uses your location in the background so friends can see live updates when you enable location sharing.
infoPlist.NSLocationAlwaysUsageDescription: ASAB uses your location in the background so friends can see live updates when you enable location sharing.
